stem: Which statement best describes one of Shirley Chisholm's most celebrated achievements?

options.label: F
options.text: Chisholm overcame gender and racial barriers to be elected to Congress.

options.label: G
options.text: Chisholm overcame physical disabilities to compete in professional sports.

options.label: H
options.text: Chisholm helped shape policies that provided famine relief in Latin America.

options.label: J
options.text: Chisholm successfully advocated the expansion of the military draft.
